title: Practice 3: с-: down, and together — раз-: apart

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: She left the path to pick some flowers.
exercises.why: The prefix "с-" implies the following meanings: (a) to descend, to go down: Мы съезжаем с горы. Он сходит вниз по лестнице. (b) to come off, to drive off: Автомобиль съехал с дороги. Поезд сошёл с пути. Note that these verbs (сходить, съезжать, etc.) are usually followed by the preposition с + Gen. Wiktionary's two entries for «сходить»: сходи́ть • (sxodítʹ) impf (perfective сойти́) — to go down, to come down, to descend, to get off; to come off, to disappear; сходи́ть • (sxodítʹ) impf (perfective сойти́) — to go down, to come down, to descend, to get off; to come off, to disappear. — DLI, Lesson 63.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.ru: Она ___ с тропинки, чтобы нарвать цветов.
exercises.context: The prefix "с-" implies the following meanings: (a) to descend, to go down: Мы съезжаем с горы. (DLI, Lesson 63)

exercises.why: Он сходит вниз по лестнице. (b) to come off, to drive off: Автомобиль съехал с дороги. — DLI, Lesson 63.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.prompt: Stones were being connected along the lines like beads on a string.
exercises.context: Он сходит вниз по лестнице.

exercises.why: **свести́** — **своди́ть** — to lead, to take (from somewhere); to bring together, to throw together. **свезти́** — **свози́ть** — (perfective only, transitive) to transport, to drive, to convey; (colloquial, perfective only, transitive) to transport there and back, to drive there and back. **сле́зть** — **слеза́ть** — to come down, to get down (from), to dismount (from); (colloquial) to come down. **сойти́сь** — **сходи́ться** — to meet, to come together; to converge, to coalesce. — DLI, Lesson 63.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: свести́** — **своди́ть — to lead, to take (from somewhere); to bring together, to throw together.

exercises.why: **разнести́** — **разноси́ть** — to carry, to convey, to deliver; (colloquial) (news, rumor etc) to spread around. **развести́** — **разводи́ть** — to take along, to bring; to conduct; to part, to move apart, to pull apart, to separate. **развезти́** — **развози́ть** — to deliver, to transport (multiple people or things to their respective destinations); (colloquial, impersonal). — DLI, Lesson 63.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.prompt: The post is delivered in the morning.
exercises.context: разнести́** — **разноси́ть — to carry, to convey, to deliver; (colloquial) (news, rumor etc) to spread around.
